test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘F $ G’ means ‘F is the mother of G’.

‘F # G’ means ‘F is the father of G’.

‘F @ G’ means ‘F is the husband of G’.

‘F % G’ means ‘F is the daughter of G’.

If J @ C $ B # R, then how is J related to R?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 $
 #
 @
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Husband
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: J @ C $ B # R

It means J is the husband of C. C is the mother of B. B is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b399cb43057a09d535d4e0ec55555f5078eafd9648f3c2d56e8907a7e5d484.png] 

Thus, J is the father's father of R.

Hence, the correct answer is: **"Option 4".**
